newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Britain's TI Group bids 189 mln stg for Forsheda.
newsitem.headline: Britain's TI Group bids 189 mln stg for Forsheda.

text.p: Britain's TI Group said on Monday it had bid 189 million pounds sterling ($295.5 million) for Swedish polymer sealing group Forsheda in a move it said would double the size of TI's polymer technology operation.
TI said in a statement it would pay 247.50 crowns cash for each A-series share in Forsheda, and 225 crowns cash for each B-share.

It said the offer implied a premium of 38.9 percent per B-series share on the price of 162 crowns per share last paid on September 30, the day on which trade in Forsheda was suspended on the Stockholm bourse.
The premium over the average price paid over the past month for the unlisted A-series share was 44.2 percent, TI said.
Forsheda said on Monday its board recommended shareholders to accept the takeover bid.
"Forsheda's board of directors recommends B-series shareholders to accept the offer," Forsheda said in a statement. ($ = 0.639 British Pounds Sterling)
